src/engine/renderer/loop.ts.reason: Instance lifecycle and grouped frame scheduling share renderer invariants and remain auditable as one state machine.
src/engine/renderer/loop.ts.revisitWhen: Split scheduling from compositing when another scheduling dimension, such as adaptive per-group cadence, is introduced.

src/engine/glow/glow.ts.reason: The glow state machine and its per-frame update are tightly coupled.
src/engine/glow/glow.ts.revisitWhen: Extract pure color or relocation stages when focused tests are introduced.

src/engine/reflection/paint.ts.reason: Target ownership and its canvas paint pipeline share cached target state.
src/engine/reflection/paint.ts.revisitWhen: Revisit when multi-anchor ownership is implemented.

src/engine/shaders.ts.reason: Most lines are one GLSL program whose locality is more valuable than artificial splitting.
src/engine/shaders.ts.revisitWhen: Split only when a second independently compiled shader program is added.
